book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: The Henrietta was a fast ship.
And Fogg had become her captain, and knew how to sail.
And Passepartout could not believe it: my master a captain!

sentences.ar: وأول أسبوع، البحر هادي، والفحم كتير.
sentences.en: And the first week, the sea was calm, the coal plentiful.
And then, a storm.

sentences.ar: والسفينة بتمشي ضد الريح، والفحم بيخلص بسرعة.
sentences.en: And the ship going against the wind, the coal burning fast.

sentences.ar: والمهندس قال لفوغ: يا سيدي، الفحم بيكفي ليوم.
sentences.en: And the engineer told Fogg: sir, the coal is enough for a day.
And Liverpool is three days off.
Fogg thought.
And then said: bring the captain.

sentences.ar: وجابوا سبيدي، وهو بيصرخ، ووجهه أحمر.
sentences.en: And they brought Speedy, shouting, his face red.
Speedy said: pirate!
Thief!
I will hang you!

sentences.ar: قال فوغ: يا كابتن، بدي أشتري سفينتك.
sentences.en: Fogg said: captain, I want to buy your ship.
Speedy said: no!
Fogg said: because I want to burn her.
Speedy said: burn the Henrietta?!
Fogg said: only the wood.
The coal is gone.
Fogg said: sixty thousand dollars.
And Speedy was silent.
The ship was worth fifty.
And said: and the iron hull stays mine?
Fogg said: yours.
Speedy said: agreed.
And took the money, and said: you are mad.
But a madman I like.
And they began to burn.
The deck, the cabins, the doors, the masts.
Everything wooden went into the engine.
A day, two days.

sentences.ar: والسفينة صارت حديد بس، وناس، ودخان.
sentences.en: And the ship became only iron, and people, and smoke.
And on the third day, the shore.
Ireland.
And after it, Liverpool.
21 December. 11:40 in the morning.
And the London train six hours.
And Fogg said: we arrive at six.

sentences.ar: قبل الموعد بساعتين وخمس وأربعين دقيقة.
sentences.en: Two hours and forty-five minutes before the deadline.
